Draw the construct structure

Source: R/construct.R
gg_construct.Rd

One row per model and one tile per scale (what = "alpha") or per pair of scales (what = "cor"), averaged over attempts. Red means lower than in real people, blue means higher, pale means a match. With "alpha", the tile is the synthetic minus the real alpha and the number is the synthetic alpha (the real alpha is in the column label). With "cor", the tile and the number are the synthetic minus the real correlation between two scales.

Usage

gg_construct(x, what = c("alpha", "cor"), title = NULL, subtitle = NULL)

Arguments

x

a result of synthetic_construct().

what

"alpha" or "cor".

title, subtitle

plot titles. NULL uses the defaults.

Value

A ggplot object.

See also

synthetic_construct()

# see synthetic_construct()
